conclusion: The October 17 Orca integration and large-project benchmarks remain historical at their original anchors. Current support verification additionally covers complete organic concentric contact contours and medial center finishing, alongside stepped-contact root continuity and height modulation. These are current source-bound native and test2 results; they do not establish a new upstream merge, remote-ref state, GUI interaction result or large-project benchmark.

verification.method: Manual source review, rotated narrow-contact regression, complete organic and contact/fill regression groups, two native Release exports and actual path/height analysis.
verification.summary: Independent offsets of a contact boundary and its walls allowed the wall keepout to split concentric loops. Axis-aligned center probes additionally produced parallel strokes and failed rotation invariance. Derive the infill boundary from the innermost printed wall with a numerical inset, and use the existing medial-axis fallback for compact organic contact remainders, dropping only sub-bead branch fragments when a longer center exists.
